sources.content: A Boise-area rock climbing gym will close its doors later this year after more than a decade, citing leasing disagreements with the property manager and difficulty finding a new space. sources.content: This year, linear TV viewership continued to diminish, albeit at varying paces. Italy is the country maintaining the highest viewing time, averaging 3h 32mins daily in H1 2026, losing just three minutes compared to the previous year.
